messages:
frank: quick heads-up — ran into a redaction race when toggling REDACT_REQIDS at runtime in the node sampleapp. repro attached.

yasmin: wait we let folks flip that at runtime? how are you toggling it?

frank: via the admin endpoint we added for demos: `/admin/env?key=REDACT_REQIDS&val=false`. sequence I used:
1) start sampleapp with REDACT_REQIDS=true LOG_LEVEL=info OTEL_AUTO=1
2) fire steady load (~200rps)
3) hit admin toggle to false then true again a few times
4) tail logs -> intermittent raw req ids show up even though config reports REDACT_REQIDS=true

peter: interesting. looks like a cache/hot-swap ordering issue. our logger caches the flag at init, but we do a hot-swap of middleware which is enqueued async. OTEL exporter can merge semantic attrs on a later tick, so redaction can miss those merged attrs.

rachel: can you paste a small snippet?

frank: example lines: `INFO 2026-03-24T14:02:01Z handler processed user=marie req_id=9af3b1c2-... status=200` then later `INFO admin toggled REDACT_REQIDS=false` then another `INFO handler processed user=marie req_id=9af3b1c2-...` (raw uuid) despite toggle showing true afterwards.

yasmin: oh oof. From an onboarding perspective toggles are nice but unsafe for privacy-toggling.

peter: potential fixes: (A) make the admin toggle do a synchronous swap (blocking) so middleware order is deterministic; (B) add a final-pass structured redactor that always runs immediately before serialization and is idempotent; (C) forbid runtime toggles for redact-related keys and require restart.

rachel: I prefer B + a note that toggles that affect redaction require a restart. B is low friction and keeps good UX.

frank: agreed. I prototyped B: final sync redaction hook that walks record keys (req_id, x-request-id, request_id, x-rd-req) and applies uuid masking, and we make redactor safe to run multiple times. also change admin route to trigger a graceful logger restart (not fire-and-forget).

peter: also add a unit test that flips the toggle during a heavy load and asserts no raw ids in output, plus an e2e replay in staging across node18/node20. microtask scheduling differences bit us before.

frank: PR opened: frank/runtime-redact-toggle-fix. includes tests + short README note advising not to flip redact toggles in public shared staging.

audit-bot: created ticket INF-314: "runtime-redact-toggle-race" severity=medium, linked PR frank/runtime-redact-toggle-fix

yasmin: will validate staging after CI green. can you add a short troubleshooting snippet to sampleapp/tools to print current hook order (`REDACT_DEBUG=1`) so integrators can debug ordering?

frank: added that to the PR too. debug snippet prints hook stack and timestamps.

rachel: great. once CI + staging replay pass, let's update onboarding doc to recommend restart for privacy toggle changes.

frank: thanks all — leaving this thread open until staging replay completes. last update 2175002700
